C0645.title: Employee Who Deleted Company Data After Non-Renewal Lawfully Dismissed
C0645.summary: Wang had worked at the company for many years. After learning that the company would not renew the labor contract, Wang deleted important data from company computers, including parts orders, sales tables, and component specifications, out of resentment. The company terminated the labor contract under its Employee Handbook, and Wang sued for compensation for unlawful termination. The Jinshan District People Court in Shanghai held that the conduct fell within circumstances allowing termination for intentionally causing economic loss to the company, upheld the dismissal, and rejected Wang compensation claim.
